# Libraries and packages

Load our custom functions for running LOESS+DE-SWAN and investigating simulation results.

```{R}
source("../null_simulations/loess_utils.R")
```

Load libraries.

```{R}
library(DEswan)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(gridExtra)
library(logr) # to log iterations for monitoring progress
```


# Figure 3 simulation 

Define simulation parameters.

```{R}
nit = 10
npred = 50
bucket = 20
logfile = "loess_notebook.log"
log_open(logfile, logdir =F)
distribution = "standard_normal"
```

Simulate age distributions.

```{R}
set.seed(1989)
uniform_ages = runif(n=200,min=20,max=80)
gaussian_ages = rnorm(n=200,mean=50, sd=8)
gaussian_mixture_ages = c(rnorm(n=100,35,6),rnorm(n=100,65,6))
```

Load iPOP age distribution from provided data for transcriptomics in the Shen et al. github.

```{R}
# replace with wget for full standalone file
ipop_sample_data = read.csv("../ext/transcriptomics/sample_info.csv")
ipop_ages = ipop_sample_data$adjusted_age
```

Test each distribution, saving the simulation results for later use.

```{R testUniform, results=F}
unif_peaks_list = list()
for(i in 1:nit)
{
  if(i %% 10 == 0)
    log_print(paste("Uniform iteration", i))
  unif_peaks_list[[i]] = test_age_dist(uniform_ages,
                              npred=npred,
                              bucket=bucket, 
                              optimize_loess = F, 
                              do_log = T,
                              distribution=distribution)
}

save(unif_peaks_list,file="uniform_loess_deswan.rda")
```

```{R testGaussian, results=F}
gaussian_peaks_list = list()
for(i in 1:nit)
{
  if(i %% 10 == 0)
    log_print(paste("Gaussian iteration", i))
  gaussian_peaks_list[[i]] = test_age_dist(gaussian_ages,npred=npred,bucket=bucket,distribution=distribution)
}
save(gaussian_peaks_list,file="gaussian_loess_deswan.rda")
```


```{R testMixtureGaussian, results=F}
gaussmix_peaks_list = list()
for(i in 1:nit)
{   
  if(i %% 10 == 0)
    log_print(paste("Gaussian mixture iteration", i))
  gaussmix_peaks_list[[i]] = test_age_dist(gaussian_mixture_ages,npred=npred,bucket=bucket,distribution=distribution)
}
save(gaussmix_peaks_list,file="gaussian_mixture_loess_deswan.rda")
```


```{R testiPOP, results=F}
ipop_peaks_list = list()
for(i in 1:nit)
{
    if(i %% 10 == 0)
    log_print(paste("ipop mixture iteration", i))
  ipop_peaks_list[[i]] = test_age_dist(ipop_ages,npred=npred,bucket=bucket,distribution=distribution)
}
save(ipop_peaks_list,file="ipop_loess_deswan.rda")
```

# Figure 3 plots

Load the results, if saved earlier.

```{R}
load("uniform_loess_deswan.rda")
load("gaussian_loess_deswan.rda")
load("gaussian_mixture_loess_deswan.rda")
load("ipop_loess_deswan.rda")
```

## Plot the age distributions.

```{R}

p1 = ggplot(data = data.frame("age"=uniform_ages), 
       aes(x=age)) + 
  geom_histogram(bins=30,color="black",fill="white") +
  ggtitle("Uniform Ages") + 
  xlim(c(20,80)) + 
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5))

p2 = ggplot(data = data.frame("age"=gaussian_ages), 
       aes(x=age)) + 
  geom_histogram(bins=30,color="black",fill="white") +
  ggtitle("Gaussian Ages") + 
  xlim(c(20,80)) + 
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5))


p3 = ggplot(data = data.frame("age"=gaussian_mixture_ages), 
       aes(x=age)) + 
  geom_histogram(bins=30,color="black",fill="white") +
  ggtitle("Gaussian Mixture Ages") + 
  xlim(c(20,80)) + 
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5))

p4 = ggplot(data = data.frame("age"=ipop_ages), 
       aes(x=age)) + 
  geom_histogram(bins=30,color="black",fill="white") +
  ggtitle("iPOP Ages") + 
  xlim(c(20,80)) + 
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5))

ageDists = arrangeGrob(p1,p2,p3,p4,nrow=1)
ggsave("age_distributions.jpeg",ageDists,width=16,height=4,dpi=400)
ageDists
```

## Plot the peaks for simulations running LOESS+DE-SWAN.

```{R}
p1 = plot_from_sim_list(unif_peaks_list, npred=npred, loess=T) + 
  ggtitle("Uniform Ages") +
  xlim(c(20,80)) + 
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size=15),plot.title = element_text(size=20, hjust=0.5),legend.position="none")


p2 = plot_from_sim_list(gaussian_peaks_list, npred=npred, loess=T) + 
  ggtitle("Gaussian Ages") +
  xlim(c(20,80)) + 
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size=15),plot.title = element_text(size=20, hjust=0.5),legend.position="none")

p3 = plot_from_sim_list(gaussmix_peaks_list, npred=npred, loess=T) + 
  ggtitle("Gaussian Mixture Ages") +
  xlim(c(20,80)) + 
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size=15),plot.title = element_text(size=20, hjust=0.5),legend.position="none")

p4 = plot_from_sim_list(ipop_peaks_list, npred=npred, loess=T) + 
  ggtitle("iPOP Ages") +
  xlim(c(20,80)) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept=44,linetype=2) + 
  annotate("text",x=39,y=500,label="Crest 1: 44") +
  geom_vline(xintercept=60,linetype=2) +
  annotate("text",x=55,y=500,label="Crest 2: 60") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size=15),plot.title = element_text(size=20, hjust=0.5),legend.position="none")

peakDists = arrangeGrob(p1,p2,p3,p4,nrow=1)
ggsave("peak_distributions.jpeg",peakDists,width=16,height=4,dpi=400)
```
